name: Now playing
author: WinDock
description: The current media session (Spotify, a browser, the Media Player app ...): album art, title and artist. Hover the widget for previous / play-pause / next over the whole face; middle-click for a popup with the controls; the wheel changes the volume and shows a volume bar beside the dock (a setting).

settings.label: Show the title and artist beside the art
settings.description: Horizontal docks only; a vertical dock shows the art.

settings.label: Scroll a long title while the pointer is over it
settings.description: 30 frames a second only while hovered (and never with reduce motion).

settings.label: The wheel changes the volume (with a volume bar)
